## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic completed 132 image captures during June 2020. The activity recorded for the month provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance. The available results are summarised below to support routine site monitoring and operational oversight.

## Image quality

Of the 132 captures, 6 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.5 per cent. The finding identifies the proportion of images that could not be used for grading and should be considered in the routine review of service delivery at West Gate Eye Clinic. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 20 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. Together, these figures describe the grading activity completed during June 2020 and the time taken for results to progress through grading. The results should be retained for ongoing operational review, with attention to both the ungradable rate and the grading lag.
